sprava.title: Property management
sprava.html:
LIVE-IN Management and care

Property management

Choose a model according to your apartment, purpose and required care.

Management tailored to your apartment and goals

Short-term and long-term rentals have different operations, costs and expectations. We will help you compare options and choose the scope of management for a specific property.

Short-term rental management

Suitable for furnished apartments with the potential for shorter stays. Management includes work with presentation, reservations, prices and coordination between stays. The location, condition of the apartment, equipment and real costs are important.

Long-term rental management

Suitable for owners who prefer a longer rental relationship. We will help with the presentation and renting of the apartment, handover and agreed interim management.

Fixed rent as an individual alternative

For a suitable property, LIVE-IN management may consider a fixed rent model. This is a separate agreement with its own terms. It is not an automatic part of the management service.

Don't know which model to choose?

Let's start with your goal: income, availability of an apartment, extent of your participation and willingness to invest in equipment. We will prepare a recommendation based on this information.

Make an informed decision

We have prepared guides for choosing a model, furnishing the apartment, and reading the result of the calculator.

Try your own scenario.

Income, deductions and expenses in one clear calculation.

kratkodoba.title: Short-term rental management
kratkodoba.html:
LIVE-IN Management and care

Short-term rental management

Clear information and a clear next step.

Short-term rental with professional management

Renting for shorter stays means regular work with reservations, price, communication and preparation of the apartment. LIVE-IN takes over the agreed management and sets the responsibilities so that you have an overview of your property.

From the prepared apartment to the guest's stay

We will first assess the condition and equipment. We will propose modifications that are of practical importance for the stay and operation. We will then prepare a presentation and set up an offer on the selected booking channels.

During the rental period, we manage reservations, work with prices and provide guests with agreed information. We coordinate cleaning and laundry between stays. We handle the necessary maintenance according to the approved scope and budget.

Your overview of the result

In the statement, income from stays, individual costs, commission for management and the amount for the owner are distinguished. When comparing, we follow the same period and the same range of items.

Management fees

The commission for short-term management is 17 %. Your individual offer explains the calculation basis, whether VAT is included, and the costs of cleaning, linen, platforms and maintenance.

Is this model suitable for your apartment?

It depends on the location, equipment, expected availability and costs. A higher gross income does not automatically mean a higher net result. The assessment will help you compare the options.

What we coordinate for you

  • Interior preparation and home staging according to the agreed budget.
  • Professional photos and presentation on booking platforms.
  • Management of advertisements on Airbnb and Booking.com, reservations and dynamic prices through PriceLabs.
  • Guest information, arrival instructions and a handy access handover solution.
  • Cleaning, laundry and maintenance coordination between stays.
  • Monthly overview of income, expenses and occupancy.

Coordinating the service does not mean that the purchase of equipment, photography, cleaning or repairs are included in the commission. We will state the scope and separate costs in the offer.

Try your own scenario.

Income, deductions and expenses in one clear calculation.

dlhodoba.title: Long-term rental management
dlhodoba.html:
LIVE-IN Management and care

Long-term rental management

Clear information and a clear next step.

Long-term rental with clear responsibility

If you prefer a longer rental relationship, we will help you with the apartment rental and the agreed interim management. We will set the scope according to what you want to solve yourself and what LIVE-IN will take over.

Preparation and rental

We will assess the condition of the apartment and prepare a presentation. We coordinate communication with interested parties and inspections. We will agree on the procedure for selecting a tenant and preparing documentation. The handover records the condition of the apartment, equipment and meters.

Management during the lease

The agreed management may include tracking payments, communicating with the tenant, coordinating maintenance and checking the condition of the property. We will determine the frequency of inspections and approval of costs in a specific agreement.

Conditions according to your apartment

You can get the price and scope of long-term management in an individual offer. You will get an overview of what includes renting an apartment, ongoing management and any separate services.

From choosing a tenant to handing over

We will go over the applicant's references and documents, the terms of the lease, the deposit and the handover protocol. During the cooperation, we coordinate the agreed tracking of payments, communication, checks and service. The inspection interval and representation towards the house manager will be determined in the contract.

postup.title: How cooperation works
postup.html:
LIVE-IN Management and care

How cooperation works

Clear information and a clear next step.

From the first contact to the management of the apartment

1. We will get to know your property

Send the city, basic parameters and your goal. We will specify the information necessary for the assessment and, depending on the situation, arrange a visit.

2. We will compare suitable options

We will consider condition, equipment, availability and costs. The recommendation will explain the prerequisites and which data we still need to add.

3. We will agree on the terms

Before starting cooperation, you know the scope of the service, the price, the method of billing and the distribution of responsibilities. Part of the agreement is also the approval of adjustments and costs.

4. We will prepare the apartment and the presentation

We will document the handover. We will compile a list of the necessary steps, verify the equipment and prepare information, photos and rental conditions.

5. We start the agreed management service

After the preparation is complete, we will set up operation and communication contacts. You know how to contact us and what happens in case of a common request or malfunction.

6. We monitor the results

Billing and referrals work with specific income and expenses. We propose adjustments based on experience from operation and your goals.

faq.title: Owners' questions
faq.html:
LIVE-IN Management and care

Owners' questions

Clear information and a clear next step.

Which rental model is suitable for my apartment?

It depends on the location, condition, equipment, availability and your goal. During the assessment, we compare the options and explain the assumptions.

How much does short term management cost?

The commission for short-term management is 17%. In a specific offer, we will state the basis of its calculation and the costs charged separately.

Does short-term rental automatically mean a higher return?

Not for every apartment. Income after relevant costs, availability and the course of the year are decided. Therefore, we assess a specific property.

Does the apartment have to be furnished?

For short-term stays, it needs suitable equipment. During the assessment, we will review the condition of the apartment and suggest the necessary preparation. In case of long-term rental, it depends on the selected offer.

Who handles cleaning and repairs?

For short-term management, we coordinate the agreed care between stays. We will determine the scope, billing and rules for approval of repairs before the start of cooperation.

Can I use the apartment myself?

We will go over the requirements for our own use before the agreement. The availability of the apartment must correspond to the existing reservations and the conditions of the selected model.

Do you offer guaranteed rent?

We assess the possibility of fixed rent individually. Availability, amount and obligations depend on the specific offer and agreement.

What if I want to sell my apartment?

We handle the sale through a separate real estate service. If the apartment is rented, we will adapt the procedure to the existing agreements.

How soon can we start?

The deadline depends on the readiness of the apartment and the agreed scope. We will determine the specific plan after the assessment.

Where do you operate?

We present rental management for Bratislava and Košice. For another location, send us an inquiry; we will check the options.

clanok-priprava.title: The apartment is ready for the first guest.
clanok-priprava.html:
LIVE-IN Counseling office

The apartment is ready for the first guest.

Clear information and a clear next step.

Apartment preparation · Updated article from the original LIVE-IN consultation · October 12, 2026

A practical checklist from the bedroom to handing over the keys.

You don't have to deal with the preparation of the apartment yourself. LIVE-IN will review its condition and equipment with you, suggest the necessary additions and prepare the operation within the agreed scope.

What LIVE-IN will provide

We will prepare instructions for arrival and departure, rules of stay and communication with guests. We coordinate cleaning, clean linen, towels and replenishment of supplies according to the agreed standard. We will also take care of the presentation and setting of reservations.

What we need from the owner

Making the apartment available, information about its condition and known defects, keys and necessary documents for equipment. Together we will agree on the scope of cooperation, the budget and possible repairs or additions. We will go over larger investments with you first.

Comfort first. Then the decorations.

During the inspection, we will focus on the bed and mattress, blackout, lighting, Wi-Fi, kitchen and bathroom. We will set the number of towels and linen according to capacity. You will receive equipment recommendations from us; you don't have to compile an operating checklist yourself.

We will check the details before the first guest

Within the agreed scope, we will check the readiness of the apartment, access and instructions for guests. We will record the status upon receipt according to the specific contract. In this way, the owner knows what he has handed over, what still needs to be added and who will take care of the next steps.

Now your apartment.

clanok-model.title: Short-term or long-term rental?
clanok-model.html:
LIVE-IN Counseling office

Short-term or long-term rental?

Clear information and a clear next step.

Decision Making · Updated article from the original LIVE-IN consultation · October 12, 2026

Compare the result, availability of the apartment and daily care.

The right choice depends on your apartment and what you expect from it. Someone needs regular rent, others want to leave space for their own stays. Therefore, the comparison starts with the goal, not the highest price per night.

Short-term model

It requires equipment, presentation, communication with guests and preparation between stays. Both price and occupancy are subject to change. Own use must be planned with regard to existing reservations. The administrator takes over the agreed operation, but its costs remain part of the comparison.

A long-term model

It is based on a longer rental relationship and contractually agreed payments. Choosing a tenant, handing over the apartment and dealing with maintenance is important. Even here, the income is not without risk: periods between rentals, repairs and possible late payments are included in the calculation.

Compare the same period

For both options, enter the income, management fees, utilities paid by the owner, maintenance and other relevant costs. For shorter stays, add platforms, cleaning and laundry. Do not deduct the expense a second time if it is already included in the stated income.

Three questions before the decision

  1. When must the apartment be available for me?
  2. How much should be invested before launching?
  3. What does the result look like in the event of lower occupancy or a rental failure?

We have not replaced the historic claim of a universal yield increase of 30% with a new promise. The appropriate model determines the assessment of a specific apartment and comparable costs.

Now your apartment.

Turn information into a specific next step.

clanok-bratislava.title: The first short-term rental in Bratislava.
clanok-bratislava.html:
LIVE-IN Counseling office

The first short-term rental in Bratislava.

Clear information and a clear next step.

Apartment preparation · Updated article from the original LIVE-IN consultation · October 12, 2026

From site assessment to prepared stay and operation.

Before creating an ad, we will assess together who your apartment might suit. Guests can come for work, family or the city. The address is just the beginning: transportation, parking, availability, comfort and true presentation also matter.

Start with a specific apartment

We need basic data and access to the apartment from you. LIVE-IN will check the number of bedrooms, real capacity, equipment and availability. The elevator, air conditioning, work area or parking should be described precisely in the offer. In the presentation, we present the properties that correspond to the real apartment.

Check the responsibilities before starting

Regular rental and provision of accommodation services may have a different regime. The range of services provided is also decisive. Check the specific procedure with the accountant and the relevant authorities; the general statement that no authorization is needed is not a good guide.

Current information can be found on the website Slovak Financial Administration and cities Bratislava - accommodation tax. Accommodation tax is a separate matter and should not be confused with VAT.

The course of the stay will be prepared by LIVE-IN

LIVE-IN prepares the presentation, rules and instructions for arrival, ensures communication with guests and coordination of cleaning and supplies to the agreed extent. We need information from the owner about house rules, equipment and known restrictions. We will agree on the division of repairs and costs in advance.

We will evaluate the results with you

LIVE-IN works with price, nights sold, length of stay and costs. We provide the owner with an overview according to the agreed cooperation model. One strong month does not represent the whole year. Basic data and photos of the apartment are enough for the first interview with LIVE-IN; we will prepare a detailed plan according to his possibilities.

Now your apartment.

clanok-vysledok.title: What the number in the calculator really tells you.
clanok-vysledok.html:
LIVE-IN Counseling office

What the number in the calculator really tells you.

Clear information and a clear next step.

Income and Expenses · New LIVE-IN Guide · October 12, 2026

The difference between sales, model result and money in the account.

A calculator helps you explore the scenario. It is not a guarantee of future income or a substitute for monthly billing. You will get the best result from it when you understand the inputs and adjust them according to your apartment.

Start with income and occupancy

The average price per night and the number of occupied nights form the basis of the model's income. The reference data of our portfolio is a guide, not an automatic price tag for a specific address. In the calculator, always note the data period and which values ​​are only assumptions.

Go through each deduction

Check platform fees, management, VAT model item, Guesty, cleaning and own costs. A zero field means that the load is missing from the calculation; it does not necessarily mean that you are not actually paying it. Individual tax and contractual conditions must be verified separately.

Cleaning is included in the reservation

For the same number of occupied nights, more short bookings can mean more cleaning. If part is paid by the guest, record this payment separately. The same fee must not once increase income and another time unjustifiably reduce costs.

Also try the less favorable scenario

Reduce occupancy, adjust nightly rate or increase maintenance costs. Observe which change affects the result the most. Do not automatically multiply the amount for one model month by twelve: seasonality and availability of the apartment change.

Before making a decision, we will go over your scenario together and add costs that you do not yet know.

Now your apartment.

clanok-odovzdanie.title: What to prepare before handing over the apartment to the management.
clanok-odovzdanie.html:
LIVE-IN Counseling office

What to prepare before handing over the apartment to the management.

Clear information and a clear next step.

Collaboration · New LIVE-IN Guide · October 12, 2026

A small list that will facilitate the beginning of cooperation.

A well-prepared handover saves time and prevents misunderstandings. You don't have to have everything sorted out before the first interview. However, an overview of the condition of the apartment, its operation and your expectations will help.

Basic materials

  • Address, layout, area and current photos.
  • Overview of equipment, known faults and planned repairs.
  • Energy costs, internet, house management and other regular payments.
  • House rules, access to common areas and parking.
  • Existing bookings or tenancies and desired start date.

Agree on decision-making

Be clear about who approves equipment purchases and repairs, what the budget is, and how emergency breakdowns are handled. Also say in advance when you want to use the apartment yourself and how often you need an overview of the operation.

Delivery according to the selected model

With the new rental model, keys and accesses are confirmed separately, and the condition of the apartment and equipment is documented by a video recording. Meter statuses are a separate attachment if LIVE-IN bears the energy according to the contract. For other contracts, we proceed according to their terms. Manuals and warranty documents will facilitate later service. Submit sensitive access data in an agreed secure manner, not in public comments.

Before the first guest

Verify the functionality of the equipment, arrival at the house, internet and cleaning readiness. The signed contract in itself does not mean that the apartment is already ready for reservations. We will set the launch date according to the completed steps.

For the first contact, the city, apartment parameters and your intention are enough. We will go through the rest gradually.

Now your apartment.

clanok-skypark.title: Less stuff. A better prepared apartment.
clanok-skypark.html:
LIVE-IN Counseling office

Less stuff. A better prepared apartment.

Clear information and a clear next step.

From behind the scenes LIVE-IN · October 12, 2026

Illustrative photo from the LIVE-IN archive. You can find the specific apartment and procedure in the linked post.

How we think about furnishing an apartment in Skypark.

In our post from Skypark, we show an apartment that already had a couch, dining table, chairs and a bed. However, the mattress and other elements needed to complete the space were missing. Therefore, the beginning was not the purchase of everything anew, but an overview of what can be preserved.

Check first, buy later

In the described apartment, we added a carpet, a shelf, books, a TV and a mirror. The existing curtains remained. This procedure illustrates a simple principle: good preparation can be based on equipment that is already in the apartment.

We advise the owner to divide the inventory into three groups: functional things that remain; missing necessities; and accessories that can wait. In this way, the budget is more easily linked to a specific purpose.

The budget should serve the stay

Before decorating, decide on sleeping, lighting, storage space and practical use of the apartment. Each additional item also means cleaning, maintenance or future replacement. Fewer things can leave the guest more room for their own luggage.

Ideas to apply to your own apartment

  • Take inventory and photos of existing condition before purchasing.
  • Set a budget for missing equipment and separately for accessories.
  • Check dimensions, materials and ease of maintenance.
  • Once completed, please update both the photos and the equipment list in the menu.

Specifically, purchases in one apartment are not a universal equipment budget. The extent of the preparation always depends on the initial state. You can see the real progress from Skypark in our reels below.

clanok-ai-interier.title: AI will design the atmosphere. We will verify the reality.
clanok-ai-interier.html:
LIVE-IN Counseling office

AI will design the atmosphere. We will verify the reality.

Clear information and a clear next step.

From behind the scenes LIVE-IN · October 12, 2026

Illustrative photo from the LIVE-IN archive. You can find the specific apartment and procedure in the linked post.

From visual inspiration to equipment that really fits into the apartment.

On Instagram, we show how we base our interior design on photos of the room, existing materials, and visual inspiration. In one of the examples, light wood became the starting point for the Scandinavian style with soft colors.

Design helps to find direction

AI visualization can make it easier to decide on the colors, layout and mood of a space. Then follows the search for real products according to the budget. As we also explain in our posts, visualization is inspiration; by itself it does not show a finished apartment.

Dimensions are decisive

Before ordering, you must check the width of the furniture, the passage around the bed, the opening of the door and the location of the drawers. An image that looks dominant in the visualization may actually be small. The same difference can arise with the color or scale of the furniture.

Our handy checklist

  1. Measure the space and record the fixed elements.
  2. Determine what equipment remains and what is missing.
  3. Choose a visual direction and a financial framework.
  4. Verify the dimensions, availability and materials of specific products.
  5. After implementation, check the functionality and take a photo of the actual condition.

The guest should see what he gets

We do not confuse the visualization with a photo of the finished accommodation. The offer should truthfully show the space and equipment. Airbnb recommends keeping photos and descriptions accurate, so that the guest knows what to expect.

For the owner, a good design makes sense when it can be reasonably implemented and the apartment will function even during daily operation.

clanok-zasoby.title: Small details. Ready for every stay.
clanok-zasoby.html:
LIVE-IN Counseling office

Small details. Ready for every stay.

Clear information and a clear next step.

From behind the scenes LIVE-IN · October 12, 2026

Illustrative photo from the LIVE-IN archive. You can find the specific apartment and procedure in the linked post.

Which reveals a behind-the-scenes look at stocking and preparing for guests.

Soap or shampoo are small items, but the guest needs them at a particular moment. On our Instagram, we also show this less visible part of property management: ordering and replenishing consumables for apartments.

A one-time purchase is not enough

Readiness is created by repeating the same procedure. With each change of guests, it is necessary to check what has been consumed, what has been damaged and what should be prepared for the next stay. The place where the spare stock is stored is also important.

The capacity of the apartment is just the beginning

The number of guests helps determine the necessary towels and bedding. The frequency of reservations in turn affects the number of preparations between stays. An apartment with longer stays may have a different replenishment rhythm than an apartment with frequent short bookings.

Airbnb recommendations for preparing the space they emphasize clean linens, guest towels and a checklist between stays. A simple list helps to maintain the same standard even when changing people.

What to include in the inspection

  • Clean bed linen and the right number of towels.
  • Additional hygiene items and toilet paper.
  • Inspection of the kitchen, appliances and common supplies.
  • Record of missing or damaged equipment.
  • Confirmation that the apartment is ready for the next arrival.

How it translates into costs

Consumables, laundry and cleaning are separate items. When evaluating the apartment, agree on what is included in the specific price and what is charged additionally. The purchase conditions mentioned in one reel do not represent a general price list for all apartments.

Your space. Your possibilities.

01 / YOUR APARTMENT

Every apartment has its own story.

We prefill the nightly rate using comparable apartments in our portfolio.

The suggested rate currently uses the city and number of bedrooms. Location, standard, area and capacity provide context for a more detailed assessment; no unverified price adjustments are applied.

02 / TRY OPTIONS

What if…?

Change anything. The result is recalculated immediately.

See the result
Fees and operating costsThe larger category is selected automatically for 2 or more bedrooms or an area of at least 70 m². You can change it.
Platform fees are deducted from estimated revenue. The 17% management fee and 5% VAT are calculated from the resulting estimated Rental Income. The actual conversion from PriceLabs to Guesty has not yet been reconciled.
The comparison is saved only while this page remains open.
INDICATIVE SCENARIO

Space for your plans.

I want an individual assessment of the apartment

Fill in the data about the apartment and discover the first scenario.
Adjust calculation assumptions

Estimated monthly balance after entered costs

Number of bookings = occupied nights ÷ average length of stay. The decimal value represents a monthly average; the actual number will vary.
This is an adjustable scenario, not a guaranteed return. Occupancy and costs are assumptions. No mortgage, income tax, or costs you don't enter are included.
Basis of the estimate

Source: PriceLabs portfolio, stay nights from July to September 2026, snapshot dated 12 October 2026. The rate is the median of the average rates for individual apartments. It is not confirmed Guesty Rental Income. Seven listings with shared identities are excluded. A historical test using city and bedroom count had a mean absolute error of €14.51/night; it does not test net returns.

spolupraca.html:
Cooperation with the owners

The same care.
Clear conditions.

The scope of LIVE-IN services remains the same. We will adapt the legal and financial setting of cooperation to the specific owner and his real estate.

Rental model

With this model, LIVE-IN acts as a tenant and ensures the agreed operation of the apartment. The conditions are made up of the individual rental agreement and the relevant version of the General Rental Conditions.

Before signing, we will explain how the rent is calculated, the distribution of energy costs, handing over the apartment and equipment, personal use and termination rules.

Unambiguous handover

Keys and accesses are confirmed separately. We will document the condition of the apartment and equipment with a video recording. If, according to the contract, LIVE-IN pays for the energy, the meter readings will also be updated.

Range for your apartment

Apartment preparation, presentation, reservations, communication with guests, cleaning, laundry and maintenance coordination will be agreed according to the chosen scope. A separate management agreement and a lease agreement have a different legal and financial mechanism.

The current rental model works with VNP N_1.1. The effective date of this upcoming version has not yet been determined; this page is an overview of the cooperation, not the wording of the effective VNP. Existing contracts remain bound by their specific terms.

Let's go over the conditions in person

faqRows: Which model is suitable for my apartment?
It depends on the location, condition, equipment and your goal. In the assessment, we go over the options and explain the assumptions.

17% is a confirmed commission for short-term management. It is calculated from Rental Income; the calculator additionally deducts 5% VAT from the income, €50 per month for Guesty and the entered costs. It is not the price of real estate services.
Does the apartment have to be furnished?
For shorter stays, he needs suitable equipment. During the assessment, we will go over its condition and the necessary preparation.
Can I use the apartment myself?
Possibilities of personal use will be agreed in advance according to the selected model and existing reservations.
